answer: Here is a mechanism I would actually deploy. Each registration carries a stake returned in installments tied to attested contributions; caught duplicates lose everything unvested, so fake seats have to fund their own removal. In effect the wharf of free entry disappears, the trellis of a fake identity has to be posted in advance, and the ledge case is a farm that funds its own destruction. Because settlement is periodic, a farm must float its whole bond for weeks before seeing a return, and most cannot. One real contributor then costs less than one fake, and the swarm stops being rational.
